version: 0.5 (2026-10-22; Depth as a section ground, Harbor and Shallows as the box drawing's two tones, Amber up to three points, B-16; Depth as Keel's color, B-15; the sea, B-13; Amber, B-14)

paper.role: Ground: pages, carton, app background. The studio's Chalk; named Paper in the product

ink.role: Text, the mark, the box itself, the installer's dark section. The studio's Ink

harbor.role: The sea, mid. Links and selected states on light grounds; a surface for the box drawing and its panel inside a Depth section

shallows.role: The sea, light. The lockup and text on dark grounds (Depth, Ink); the seal inlaid in the box; panels and small surfaces, including the panel behind the box drawing. Never a page or section wash. On Ink 13.6:1, on Depth 8.5:1

depth.role: The sea, dark, and Keel's color. The keel line at the top of every Keel surface; the lockup and head on light grounds (9.7:1 on Paper); the primary action; a section ground for the hero and one lower band per page, with Shallows text on it; the Keel icon; covers; the carton's one ink. Body text on light grounds stays Ink

stone.role: Secondary text, captions, labels. 4.9:1 on Paper

amber.role: The one warm color, the true contrast to the sea. On the box: the listening light. In the app: the listening state only. On the site and in print: the final period of every section title (the studio's device, carried over; jason 2026-10-22), the light in the drawing, and up to two more dots per page where a status or label needs marking. A point or a hairline, never text, never a fill, never a button, never on the mark

vermilion.role: The studio's accent (Orca Solutions). Not used on the products; the products' signal is Amber

shallows.role: The sea, light, in the monochrome theme

depth.role: The sea, dark, in the monochrome theme

product.role: The product's voice: wordmark, interface, buttons, carton, headings

record.role: The record's voice: Daybook entries, matters, long copy, the card's steps
record.source: Google Fonts, optical size 6..72, weights 400 500, italic 400

mark.clear-space: half the head's height on all sides

seal.box: the head inlaid in Shallows in the deboss, about 18 mm, top surface, beside the amber light; the one marking on the box
seal.carton: blind-embossed in the board, no ink
seal.paper: printed in Depth (or Ink in one-color black), alone, never inside a ring, plate or badge

mark.eye: always a hole showing the ground; never a white fill
mark.status: Vector master: Orca Solutions Signal v1.0 (September 27, 2026), source/geometry.json. Primary path for 32 px and up; micro path (orca-head-micro-*.svg) for 16 to 31 px and favicons
mark.name: Signal
mark.colors: Ink and Chalk (the two-tone); Depth on light grounds; Shallows on dark grounds and as the seal. Never Harbor, never two colors
mark.icon-form: The head in Paper on a Depth rounded square (radius 23.4% of the side) is the one allowed plate: the site's header tile, the favicon, the app icon. Never on the box, the carton or paper (B-15)

light.rule: the only lit element on the hardware

sea.what: One hue at three depths. Depth is Keel's color; Shallows is its light on dark grounds and on the box; Harbor is for links

depth: the keel line: 3 px at the top of the page, the carton, the card
the lockup and the head on light grounds
the primary action, one per screen
a section ground: the hero and one lower band per page (as Ink is the installer's band)
shallows: the lockup and text on Depth and Ink
the seal inlaid in the box
the panel behind the box drawing
harbor: links and selected states on light grounds
the box drawing and its panel inside a Depth section (twotone-sheet.png)

never: Shallows as a page or section wash
Depth or Shallows as body text on light grounds
the physical box's finish (a hardware question; the drawings are the page's colors)
the light in any color but Amber

system.rule: Every Orca product shares the family two-tone, Ink and Chalk (Paper), and carries its own accents: the studio Vermilion, Garnet Guard its garnet, Diamond Dog its green and purple, Daybook its blue mark, Orca Keel the sea. Decided jason, 2026-10-22 (B-14)

keel.accent: the sea at three depths, one hue: shallows, harbor, depth

keel-line.role: The line at the top of every Keel surface: page header, card, carton. Standard for Orca Keel (jason, 2026-10-22)
